h.en: 10.1.1 Refrigeration — moving heat, not creating cold

body.en:
Refrigeration removes heat from a lower-temperature space and rejects it to a warmer environment using an energy input. A refrigerator does not destroy heat or create cold as a substance.

For an idealised steady boundary balance, heat rejected = cooling heat absorbed + input work, with other exchanges treated appropriately. Room air conditioning also involves airflow, comfort and often moisture control; it is not identical to food refrigeration.
body.gu:
Refrigeration energy input વડે lower-temperature જગ્યા માંથી heat કાઢીને warmer environment માં છોડે છે. Heat destroy અથવા cold નામનો substance બનાવતું નથી.

Simple steady balance માં rejected heat = absorbed cooling heat + work input. Room AC માં airflow/comfort અને ઘણીવાર moisture control પણ છે; food refrigeration જેવું જ બધું નથી.

body.en:
A refrigerant circulates through the system, absorbing/rejecting energy as its state changes. In common vapour-compression teaching cycles it evaporates at low pressure to absorb heat and condenses at higher pressure to reject it.

Selection considers pressure/temperature performance, compatibility, toxicity, flammability and environmental/regulatory constraints. Not every refrigerant is harmless, and names cannot be substituted without redesign/service approval. Never vent refrigerant or open charged lines.
body.gu:
Refrigerant circulate થઈ state changes મારફતે heat absorb/reject કરે. Common vapour-compression cycle માં low p પર evaporate થઈ heat લે અને higher p પર condense થઈ heat છોડે.

Selection performance, compatibility, toxicity, flammability અને environmental rules પરથી. દરેક refrigerant harmless નથી; random substitute નહીં. Charged line ખોલવી/vent કરવું નહીં.

body.en:
The basic loop is compressor → condenser → expansion device → evaporator → compressor. Connecting pipes and controls maintain appropriate state/flow. The compressor normally receives vapour, not a damaging liquid slug.

High-pressure and low-pressure sides are separated by compressor action and the expansion device. The working fluid is recirculated rather than consumed as fuel in the normal sealed cycle.
body.gu:
Basic loop: Compressor → Condenser → Expansion device → Evaporator → Compressor. Pipes/controls state/flow રાખે. Compressor સામાન્ય vapour લે, damaging liquid slug નહીં.

High/low pressure sides compressor/expansion device થી બને. Normal sealed cycle માં refrigerant recirculate થાય; fuel તરીકે consume નથી થતું.

body.en:
The compressor uses work to raise vapour pressure; discharge temperature generally rises. In the condenser, the hot high-pressure refrigerant rejects heat to ambient air/water and condenses under suitable conditions, with possible desuperheating/subcooling sections.

The condenser is the heat-rejection component, not the cold cabinet surface. Its airflow/cooling path must remain adequate. Compressor speed/type and control vary; the simple cycle is not a wiring or repair guide.
body.gu:
Compressor work વડે vapour p વધારે અને સામાન્ય discharge T વધે. Condenser માં high-p refrigerant ambient ને heat આપી condense થાય; desuperheating/subcooling પણ હોઈ શકે.

Condenser heat બહાર છોડે છે, cold cabinet surface નથી. યોગ્ય airflow જોઈએ. આ simple cycle wiring/repair guide નથી.

body.en:
A capillary tube or other expansion device restricts flow and reduces pressure through a throttling process; in an idealised steady adiabatic throttling model, enthalpy is approximately unchanged. Some liquid flashes, producing a low-pressure mixture.

In the evaporator, refrigerant absorbs heat from the cooled space/air and evaporates. It returns as suitable vapour to the compressor. A lower pressure enables a lower saturation temperature, not unlimited cooling without work.
body.gu:
Capillary/expansion device flow restrict કરીને throttling થી p ઘટાડે. Ideal steady adiabatic model માં enthalpy લગભગ constant; થોડું liquid flash થઈ low-p mixture બને.

Evaporator cooled space/air માંથી heat લે અને refrigerant evaporate થાય; યોગ્ય vapour compressor ને પાછું જાય. Low p થી low saturation T મળે; work વગર unlimited cooling નહીં.

body.en:
Coefficient of performance (COP) for refrigeration is desired cooling effect divided by work input under the stated system boundary. It can exceed one because it measures heat moved per work input, not a heat-engine efficiency.

The syllabus focuses on working; no detailed cycle property calculation is needed. Applications include domestic food storage, cold rooms and suitable process cooling. Temperature/humidity targets depend on the actual product and use.
body.gu:
Refrigeration COP = stated boundary માં cooling effect/work input. તે એકથી વધારે થઈ શકે કારણ કે heat moved/work છે, heat-engine efficiency નહીં.

આ unit working પર છે; detailed property numerical જરૂરી નથી. Food storage/cold rooms/process cooling ઉપયોગો; targets actual use પ્રમાણે.

body.en:
A domestic refrigerator typically combines an insulated cabinet, compressor, condenser, metering device, evaporator, temperature control and suitable airflow/defrost arrangements. Hermetic compressors enclose motor/mechanism; do not open them.

The evaporator absorbs cabinet heat; the condenser rejects cabinet heat plus work-related input to the room. Door seals and insulation reduce heat leakage. Frost-free designs circulate air and manage defrost cycles; not every refrigerator has the same coil arrangement.
body.gu:
Insulated cabinet, compressor, condenser, metering device, evaporator, temperature control અને airflow/defrost arrangement હોય. Hermetic compressor અંદર motor/mechanism બંધ હોય; ખોલવો નહીં.

Evaporator cabinet heat લે; condenser તે heat+work input room માં છોડે. Door seals/insulation heat leakage ઘટાડે. Frost-free design airflow/defrost વાપરે; દરેક coil layout same નથી.

body.en:
A window AC places indoor/outdoor functional sections in one packaged assembly. Indoor air passes over the evaporator for cooling and often dehumidification; outdoor airflow removes condenser heat. A partition helps separate air paths, but the refrigerant loop links components.

Moisture condenses on the cold coil when conditions permit and needs the specified drainage arrangement. Cooling indoor air does not mean the unit continuously supplies all required fresh ventilation; ventilation provisions are model-specific.
body.gu:
Window AC માં indoor/outdoor sections એક packaged assembly માં. Indoor air evaporator પરથી cool/ઘણીવાર dehumidify થાય; outdoor airflow condenser heat કાઢે. Partition air paths અલગ રાખે; refrigerant loop જોડાયેલ છે.

Cold coil પર moisture condense થઈ drainage જોઈએ. AC cooling એટલે બધી fresh ventilation પૂરી કરે એવું નહીં; model પ્રમાણે છે.

body.en:
A typical split AC has an indoor unit with evaporator/blower and an outdoor unit with compressor/condenser/fan, connected by refrigerant piping, electrical/control links and condensate drainage as required. Heating-capable/reversible models can change coil roles.

Separating units often reduces indoor compressor noise and allows flexible placement, but installation needs qualified leak-tight piping, correct electrical work and manufacturer-approved procedures. It is not a student refrigerant-charging practical.
body.gu:
Typical split AC indoor માં evaporator/blower અને outdoor માં compressor/condenser/fan, refrigerant pipes અને electrical/control/drain links. Reversible heating models માં coil roles બદલાય.

Indoor noise/placement લાભ હોઈ શકે; installation માટે qualified leak-tight piping/electrical procedure જરૂરી. Student charging practical નહીં.

body.en:
Window AC is a packaged wall/window assembly; split AC separates indoor/outdoor units. Compare placement, noise, installation, maintenance, capacity and total cost using actual models. “Split is always more efficient” is not universally valid.

Use diagrams or isolated training models. Do not puncture tubing, vent refrigerant, bypass pressure/electrical protection or work on live wiring. Keep airflow paths unobstructed and use manufacturer-approved user maintenance only.
body.gu:
Window packaged assembly, split separate units. Placement/noise/installation/maintenance/capacity/cost actual models મુજબ compare. Split હંમેશાં efficient rule નહીં.

Diagrams/isolated model વાપરો. Tubing puncture/vent/protection bypass/live wiring નહીં. Airflow ખુલ્લો અને approved user-maintenance જ.

a.en: No; moves heat with energy input.

terms.en: Heat out at condenser, heat in at evaporator.
terms.gu: Condenser heat બહાર, evaporator heat અંદર.

items.f: Rejected heat = cooling heat + input work (simple balance)
